scenario.summary: A user seeking AI assistance was targeted by a ClickFix social engineering attack that induced them to execute a malicious shell command via Terminal. This command stole a Microsoft 365 session cookie, enabling the attacker to bypass MFA, gain unauthorized inbox access, and perform mailbox manipulation to redirect invoice payments in a Business Email Compromise (BEC) scenario.

meta.rationale: Focus on M365 tenants with high financial risk, such as Finance or Treasury departments. Widen the lookback window if investigating a known invoice fraud incident.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has hijacked an authenticated Microsoft 365 session using stolen cookies, bypassing MFA to create stealthy inbox rules and perform fraudulent financial transactions.

hunt.name: M365 Session Hijacking and Mailbox Manipulation
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the transition from endpoint compromise to identity-based fraud. It starts by finding suspicious inbox rule creations that use minimalist or hidden naming conventions common in BEC attacks. If found, the hunt expands to analyze authentication anomalies, specifically concurrent sessions using different browser fingerprints or locations, and corroborates these with mailbox activities like unauthorized email sending or permanent deletion of evidence. This flow follows the scenario where a stolen session cookie allows an attacker to manipulate an inbox for hours without triggering MFA alerts.

nodes.label: Lead: Suspicious M365 Inbox Rule Creation

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, resource_name, api_operation, src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, time FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE provider = 'm365' AND (api_operation = 'New-InboxRule' OR api_operation = 'Set-InboxRule') AND (instr(',' || '{{suspicious_rule_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(substr(resource_name, instr(resource_name, '\') + 1)) || ',') > 0 OR LENGTH(substr(resource_name, instr(resource_name, '\') + 1)) <= 2) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify the creation or modification of inbox rules with minimalist names like '..' which attackers use to hide mailbox manipulation.
config.expected_signal: A row indicates a rule created with a near-invisible name. Silence indicates no such rules were created via the API in the window.

primitive_config.label: Lead: Suspicious M365 Inbox Rule Creation
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, resource_name, api_operation, src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, time FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE provider = 'm365' AND (api_operation = 'New-InboxRule' OR api_operation = 'Set-InboxRule') AND (instr(',' || '{{suspicious_rule_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(substr(resource_name, instr(resource_name, '\') + 1)) || ',') > 0 OR LENGTH(substr(resource_name, instr(resource_name, '\') + 1)) <= 2) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A row indicates a rule created with a near-invisible name. Silence indicates no such rules were created via the API in the window.

config.objective: Review the rule creation events and determine if they represent unusual administrative behavior for the named users.
config.description: Decide if the identified inbox rule creation warrants a full investigation of the user session.
config.expected_signal: A verdict on whether the rule name and user context are suspicious enough to continue.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of suspicious or benign for each user identified in the lead query.

config.question: the evaluate-rule-lead verdict is suspicious for at least one user
config.condition: the evaluate-rule-lead verdict is suspicious for at least one user
config.description: Limit expensive concurrency and impact queries to only those cases where a suspicious rule lead exists.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, user_agent, src_endpoint_ip, src_location_country, is_proxy, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE provider = 'm365' AND status_id = 1 AND ('{{scope_users}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_users}}' || ',', ',' || actor_user_name || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, user_agent, src_endpoint_ip, src_location_country, is_proxy
config.description: Examine the session history for flagged users to find browser-string shifts or proxy use concurrent with the rule creation.
config.expected_signal: Users with disparate browser strings or VPN use within the same window. Silence implies single-browser sessions.

primitive_config.label: M365 Session Concurrency Anomalies
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, user_agent, src_endpoint_ip, src_location_country, is_proxy, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE provider = 'm365' AND status_id = 1 AND ('{{scope_users}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_users}}' || ',', ',' || actor_user_name || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, user_agent, src_endpoint_ip, src_location_country, is_proxy
primitive_config.expected: Users with disparate browser strings or VPN use within the same window. Silence implies single-browser sessions.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, api_operation, resource_name, src_endpoint_ip, time FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE provider = 'm365' AND ('{{scope_users}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_users}}' || ',', ',' || actor_user_name || ',') > 0) AND (api_operation IN ('Send', 'MoveToDeletedItems', 'HardDelete', 'EmptyFolder') OR (api_operation = 'Update' AND LOWER(resource_name) LIKE '%inbox%')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify fraudulent emails being sent or the deletion of evidence to hide the attacker's presence, specifically for the flagged users.
config.expected_signal: A burst of email deletions or sends from a user who also showed rule anomalies. Silence indicates no destructive mailbox actions.

config.objective: Determine if the user from the lead query shows session hijacking indicators, such as a new user agent during the rule creation that differs from their history, and corresponding impact actions.
config.description: Synthesize the rule creation, the session browser shift, and the mailbox impact to confirm a BEC event.
config.expected_signal: A detailed verdict on whether session hijacking and BEC occurred.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of malicious | suspicious | benign per user, citing specific timestamps and browser strings.

config.question: the triage-investigation verdict is malicious for at least one user
config.condition: the triage-investigation verdict is malicious for at least one user
config.description: Automate the containment request if the session hijack is confirmed.
Immediately invalidate the stolen session cookie and prevent further unauthorized access.
config.instructions: Revoke all active M365 sessions for the affected user and reset the password.
